settings.networks.heading: Networks
settings.networks.intro: Manage the IRC networks saved in this browser.
settings.notifications.browserBlocked: Notifications are blocked by your browser.
settings.notifications.browserPerNetwork: Browser notifications are also per network — enabled by default, toggled in each network's settings (Edit network → “Browser notifications for this network”).
settings.notifications.browserUnsupporte: Notifications are not supported by your browser.
settings.notifications.commaList: Comma-separated, e.g.: word, some more words, anotherword
settings.notifications.highlightExceptio: If a message contains any of these comma-separated expressions, it will not trigger a highlight even if it contains your nickname or expressions defined in custom highlights.
settings.notifications.highlightHelp: Messages that mention you or match a custom highlight get a colored background and border in the channel.
settings.notifications.highlightsHelp: If a message contains any of these comma-separated expressions, it will trigger a highlight.
settings.notifications.iosNotInstalled: On iOS, push notifications are only available after installing the app to the Home Screen (Share → Add to Home Screen).
settings.notifications.keyChangeAsk: Wary — ask before renewing the subscription
settings.notifications.keyChangeIgnore: Suspicious — leave it alone; push from that server stays off until you renew from the network settings
settings.notifications.keyChangeIntro: When a server's push identity (its key) changes, this device's subscription for it stops working. Then:
settings.notifications.keyChangeTrust: Naive — renew it on the spot, without asking
settings.notifications.noHttps: Notifications are only supported over HTTPS connections.
settings.notifications.pushBlocked: The server refused the push subscription. It may require logging in (SASL) before subscribing.
settings.notifications.pushDenied: Notifications are blocked by your browser. Allow them in the browser's site settings, then try again.
settings.notifications.pushPerNetwork: Push is set up per network — turn it on or off in each network's settings (Edit network → “Push notifications for this network”), where the enrollment status is also shown. The browser delivers the notifications; each push-capable server decides whether to wake this app.
settings.notifications.serverUnsupported: Push notifications need a connected server that supports the draft/webpush capability and you to be logged in to an account.
settings.notifications.stale: A server's push identity (its key) changed, so this device's push subscription for it no longer works. Renew it from that network's settings (Edit network → “Renew push notifications”) to keep being notified while the app is closed.
settings.notifications.unsupported: Push notifications are not supported by this browser (they need the Push API, a service worker and a secure context).
